refusal.jaymoskingdoms.tired.gentle: Forgive me, %1$s, I've talked myself hoarse today. Tomorrow?
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.tired.sharp: Enough! You've had my ear all day as it is, %1$s.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.tired.timid: I... I'm worn out from talking. Could we try tomorrow?
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.tired.odd: My words are all used up today, %1$s. They grow back overnight.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.tired.child: I'm tired of talking! Ask me tomorrow!
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.hearts.gentle: We hardly know each other yet, %1$s. Give it time.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.hearts.sharp: I barely know you, %1$s. Earn it first.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.hearts.timid: I don't know you well enough for that yet...
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.hearts.odd: We're still strangers, %1$s. Strangers don't get that one.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.dislike.gentle: I'm sorry, %1$s, but I don't think much of you just now.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.dislike.sharp: I don't like you, %1$s. Why would I?
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.dislike.timid: I'd rather not... you're not someone I like.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.dislike.odd: You sit badly with me, %1$s. Like a stone in a boot.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.mood.gentle: Don't take it to heart, %1$s. It's been a bad day, that's all.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.mood.sharp: I'm in no mood today. Leave it.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.mood.odd: Grey clouds in my head today, %1$s. Come back when they've blown over.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.repeat.gentle: You've told me that one already, %1$s.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.repeat.sharp: I heard you the first time.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.repeat.odd: Again? I could tell it back to you word for word.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.gentle: I'd like to believe you, %1$s, but you've not done that. Not yet.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.sharp: You've never done any such thing. Come back when you have.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.timid: I don't think that really happened...
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.odd: A fine tale. Now go and make it true.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.luck.gentle: It just didn't land, %1$s. Try me another time.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.luck.sharp: That fell flat. Try again some other day.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.luck.odd: The moment wasn't right. Moments rarely are.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.gentle: I haven't forgotten what you did, %1$s.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.sharp: After what you did? I remember, %1$s.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.timid: I still remember what you did...
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.grudge.odd: I keep a little list, %1$s. You're on it.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.cold.gentle: I'm sorry, %1$s, but I've no warmth for you.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.cold.sharp: I've no love for you, %1$s, and you know why.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.cold.timid: I don't feel... comfortable with you.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.cold.odd: You leave a cold draught behind you, %1$s.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.distrust.gentle: I can't trust you, %1$s. Not after everything.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.distrust.sharp: I don't trust you as far as I could throw you.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.distrust.timid: I don't trust you... I'm sorry.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.distrust.odd: You've a shifty shadow, %1$s. I'm watching it.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.distrust.child: Mum says not to trust you.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.blood.gentle: It's not you, %1$s, it's... your kind. Folk here don't mix.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.blood.timid: My people don't... with your people. Sorry.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.blood.odd: Your blood smells foreign to me, %1$s. I'm not ready for it.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.blood.child: I'm not allowed to talk to your kind.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.repute.gentle: Folk in %2$s speak ill of you, %1$s. I can't be seen helping.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.repute.sharp: Your name stinks in %2$s. Mend it first.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.repute.odd: %2$s whispers your name, %1$s, and not kindly.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.young.gentle: I'm not meant to talk to strangers.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.young.sharp: I'm not meant to talk to strangers.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.young.timid: I'm not meant to talk to strangers...
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.young.odd: Strangers might be goblins in a coat.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.young.child: I'm not meant to talk to strangers!
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.friendly: That's not something I do, %1$s. Ask me anything else.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.flirty: Mm, not like that, %1$s. Try a little charm.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.gloomy: What's the point? It never ends well for me.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.sensitive: That hurt more than you meant it to, %1$s.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.greedy: What's in it for me? Nothing? Then no.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.odd: The moon and I don't agree with that.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.crabby: I don't do that. Not for anyone.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.extroverte: Ha! You'll have to do better than that.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.introverte: I'm... not one for that sort of thing.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.relaxed: Eh, not my sort of thing, %1$s.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.anxious: No, no, that makes me nervous...
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.peaceful: That doesn't sit well with me, %1$s.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.nature.upbeat: Not that one! Anything but that one.
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.tired: *They rub their eyes and wave a hand at the sky: they've talked enough today.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.hearts: *They tap their chest, then point at you, and shake their head: you're a stranger yet.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.dislike: *They look you up and down and turn their nose up: they don't like you.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.mood: *They sigh and look at the ground: it's a bad day for them.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.repeat: *They hold up a finger and nod: you've done that already.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.doubt: *They raise an eyebrow and wag a finger: they don't believe you.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.luck: *They give a small, awkward smile and a shrug: it didn't land.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.grudge: *They point at you, then at themselves, and glare: they haven't forgotten what you did.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.cold: *They fold their arms and give you a cold look.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.distrust: *They step back, eyes narrowed, and keep a hand on their purse: they don't trust you.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.blood: *They look at your face and shake their head: not with your kind.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.repute: *They point at you, then back at the town, and draw a finger across their throat: your name is bad here.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.young: *They hide behind their hands: they're not meant to talk to strangers.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.nature: *They wrinkle their nose and shake their head: that's not for them.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.gift: *They push it back into your hands with a grimace: they don't want that.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.wed: *They show you the ring on their own finger and shake their head.*
refusal.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.wed_you: *They point at the ring on your finger and frown.*
talk_busy.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.fight: *They wave you off without looking, weapon up: they're fighting.*
talk_busy.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.talk: *They hold up a hand and nod at the one they're talking to: wait your turn.*
talk_busy.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.tend: *They don't look up from the one they're tending: not now.*
talk_busy.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.dead: *They nod at the body they're seeing to: not now.*
talk_busy.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.prisone: *They jerk their head at their prisoner: not now.*
talk_busy.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.loot: *They shoo you away, hands full: not now.*
